tips.text: Cast Mag's Magnetize on the Void Angel so every shot lands on its head for Evolution III.
Stack magazine size and multishot and strip damage for Evolution III, so each pellet counts as a headshot and the Angel survives.
Run a stalled Incarnon challenge solo; Eximus kills that never register in public squads count there.
Do Evolution III inside an Angel bounty in a public squad and let the others handle the objective.
Pick Elemental Excess and Devouring Attrition and keep critical chance low; its huge damage proc only fires on non-critical hits.
Fill the other two Incarnon slots for Evolution V with Laetum and Innodem from Cavalero.
Avoid dying while charged; death wipes the Incarnon charge and form.
Stop at Holdfasts Rank 2 for Phenmor; the Voidplume Crest wall only starts at Rank 3.
Expect about 15 Zariman runs for the Pinions; the standing is short next to them.
Evolution III is the single most-asked Phenmor question; bare-mod attempts take many tries.
